verdict.rationale: 1Password is a SaaS/developer platform rather than an agent, so the official MCP server question applies. It ships two first-party MCP servers. The Environments MCP Server lets MCP clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Kiro manage Environments. A public docs MCP server at 1password.dev/mcp completed a keyless initialize handshake in a runtime probe. missing for 10: the Environments MCP Server is still Beta and is scoped to Environments (not general vault items), and there is no independent community or hands-on corroboration of agent use beyond the probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The 1Password Environments MCP Server lets MCP clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Kiro securely manage your 1Password Environments.
1Password's public docs MCP server at https://www.1password.dev/mcp completed a FULL keyless initialize handshake
